audit_metadata.audit_name: Phase 5 Completion Audit — Decision Support & Recommendation Engine

1_implementation_completeness.evidence: src/decision_support.py implements DecisionSupportEngine with evaluate_sku_recommendation, recommend, and batch_run. All 6 recommendation codes and priority hierarchy operational.

2_recommendation_taxonomy_and_hierarchy.evidence: Codes EXPEDITE_PO (P1), PLACE_PO (P2), REVIEW_PIPELINE (P3), FREEZE_REPLENISHMENT (P4), MAINTAIN_SCHEDULE (P5), DATA_UNAVAILABLE (P0) fully formalized and mapped.

3_conflict_resolution.evidence: Shortage/stockout risk strictly overrides long-term overstock/surplus. Unit test test_09_conflicting_signals_precedence passes.

4_api_contract_and_integration.evidence: POST /v1/recommendations live in api/inference.py and schemas in api/schemas.py. Tests test_10 and test_11 pass.

5_batch_artifacts_and_grain_invariants.evidence: recommendations_panel.parquet (450 rows, 31 cols, 9 origins * 50 SKUs), recommendations_latest.parquet (50 rows, 31 cols, origin 2025-09-16). Exact grain match.

6_production_universe_restriction.evidence: Exactly 50 production SKUs (SKU001 to SKU050). Zero unauthorized SKUs in panel or latest.

7_orphan_sku_quarantine.evidence: All 150 orphan SKUs (SKU051 to SKU200) strictly absent from Phase 5 outputs (0 intersections).

8_monetary_governance.evidence: valuation_basis_confirmed=False across all records. excess_inventory_value, inventory_value_at_risk, capital_at_risk are 100% null (count=0) in upstream Phase 4B artifacts and blocked in Phase 5.

9_on_order_governance.evidence: Policy B_LT preserved (horizon conditional on lead time days <= 7h). arrival_timing_confirmed=False explicitly propagated.

10_overstock_governance.evidence: N=8 weeks threshold marked explicitly as ENGINEERING_RECOMMENDATION_PENDING_BUSINESS_APPROVAL.

11_upstream_artifacts_unchanged.evidence: All upstream raw data, processed data, ML models, and Phase 4B risk scores are bitwise identical.

12_full_test_suite.evidence: 243 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed in 26.54s across entire repository.

13_sha256_hashes.evidence: Raw inventory_snapshots.csv, sku_master.csv, analysis_ready.parquet, random_forest_h1.joblib, xgboost_h2.joblib, risk_scores_panel.parquet, risk_scores_latest.parquet, risk_latest.json match pre-run hashes 100%.

14_file_change_tracking.evidence: No git repository present in workspace. Exactly 10 files created and 3 files modified for Phase 5.

15_inconsistency_and_leakage_audit.evidence: Zero leakage, zero surrogate valuations, zero in-place DataFrame mutations.

exact_findings: Finding 1: Business Decision #1 (Valuation Basis) remains unresolved. All monetary valuation metrics are blocked (None).
Finding 2: Business Decision #2 (PO Delivery Schedule Confirmation) remains unresolved. On_Order arrival timing is estimated using Policy B_LT and lead time days.
Finding 3: Business Decision #3 (Overstock Horizon Ratification) remains unresolved. N=8 weeks is implemented under ENGINEERING_RECOMMENDATION_PENDING_BUSINESS_APPROVAL.
Finding 4: Workspace directory f:\zidio is not a git repository. File changes are tracked via filesystem inventory and SHA-256 digests.
remaining_blockers: Formal executive sign-off on Business Decision #1 (Valuation Basis)
Formal executive sign-off on Business Decision #2 (PO Delivery Schedule Confirmation)
Formal executive sign-off on Business Decision #3 (Overstock Horizon Ratification)
next_milestone: Executive Review & Business Sign-off on Decisions #1-3 OR Phase 6 (Production Deployment & Dashboard/Monitoring)
